Product Name: TaskFlow Pro

Team Members

  • Only Team Member: Kyle Findley

Application Overview

TaskFlow Pro is a task management web application designed to help users organize assignments, track progress, and collaborate with team members in real time.

Technology Overview

  • Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
  • Frameworks: React (optional)
  • Backend: Node.js / Express
  • Database: MongoDB
  • Hosting: GitHub Pages / Vercel / Heroku

Proposal Last Updated

April 12, 2026

Feature List (Prioritized)

  • Create, edit, and delete tasks
  • User login and authentication
  • Assign tasks to team members
  • Track task completion status

Future Feature List

  • Real-time chat between team members
  • Mobile app version
  • Calendar integration
  • AI task suggestions

Basic Technical Features

  • Responsive layout using CSS
  • DOM manipulation with JavaScript
  • Form validation
  • Local storage for saving tasks

Advanced Technical Features

  • REST API integration
  • User authentication system (JWT)
  • Database CRUD operations
  • Real-time updates using WebSockets
